# Valuation

A valuation of an estate asset, property, or asset collection. Supports multiple valuations per entity over time — owner estimates, professional valuations, AI analyses, dealer offers, and probate-agreed figures

Source: [`v3/valuation.json`](../../v3/valuation.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/valuation.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this valuation within the INHERIT document |
| `entityType` | one of `asset`, `property`, `asset_collection` | yes | The type of entity being valued |
| `entityId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the entity being valued — an Asset.id, Property.id, or AssetCollection.id |
| `valuedAmount` | [Money](common/money.md) | yes | The valuation amount, in minor currency units |
| `valuationDate` | `string` (date) | yes | Date the valuation was performed or assessed |
| `provider` | `string` | | Who performed the valuation — the name of the person, firm, or service |
| `providerType` | one of `owner`, `professional_valuer`, `auction_house`, `dealer`, `insurance_assessor`, `tax_authority`, `ai_estimate`, `other` | | The type of person or organisation that provided the valuation |
| `valuerRegistration` | `object` | | The professional body registration of the valuer. A valuation from a RICS-registered surveyor or ASA-accredited appraiser carries significantly more weight with tax authorities and probate courts |
| `method` | one of `comparable_sales`, `replacement_cost`, `income_approach`, `market_listing`, `insurance_schedule`, `ai_analysis`, `expert_opinion`, `other` | | The valuation methodology used |
| `valuationPurpose` | one of `current_estimate`, `date_of_death`, `insurance`, `official`, `tax_return`, `dealer_offer`, `ai_estimate`, `pre_sale`, `probate` | | The purpose for which this valuation was obtained |
| `confidence` | one of `high`, `medium`, `low`, `unknown` | | Confidence level in this valuation |
| `comparables` | array of [Comparable](#def-Comparable) | | Comparable items found on marketplaces — used to support the valuation. Agent-generated comparables should include matchScore for quantitative filtering and will accumulate humanVerdict feedback over time |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this valuation — methodology details, caveats, market conditions, or disagreements with other valuations |
| `fieldProvenance` | array of [FieldProvenance](common/field-provenance.md) | | Per-field provenance records — how each field's value was obtained |
| `auctionData` | `object` | | Auction house estimate and result data |
| `validUntil` | `string` or `null` (date) | | The date until which this valuation is considered valid. Common for insurance valuations which require annual renewal. After this date, the valuation may need to be refreshed |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-Comparable"></a>

### Comparable

A comparable sale or listing used to support the valuation. Capturing comparables with screenshots and metadata creates an auditable evidence trail for executors, HMRC, and probate courts

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` (uri) | | Link to the comparable sale or listing |
| `screenshotUrl` | `string` (uri) | | Screenshot of the listing at the time it was captured. Listings are often removed after sale — the screenshot preserves the evidence |
| `title` | `string` | | Description of the comparable item |
| `salePrice` | [Money](common/money.md) | | The sale price of the comparable item, in minor currency units |
| `saleDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the comparable item sold |
| `platform` | `string` | | Where the comparable sold — marketplace, auction house, or dealer |
| `platformListingId` | `string` | | The platform-specific listing or item identifier. Enables API-driven price lookups — e.g. eBay item ID resolves via the Browse API, Chrono24 ref resolves to watch data, Discogs release ID resolves to vinyl data |
| `auctionLotRef` | `string` | | Structured auction lot reference for provenance tracking — house, sale, and lot number. Enables lookups against auction house archives and provenance databases |
| `capturedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | Timestamp when the comparable was captured or recorded. Important because market values shift and stale comparables lose evidential weight |
| `matchConfidence` | one of `exact`, `close`, `approximate`, `weak` | | How closely the comparable matches the item being valued |
| `matchFactors` | array of `string` | | What makes this item comparable — the specific attributes that justify the comparison |
| `matchNotes` | `string` | | Free-text notes explaining the comparison — differences, adjustments, or caveats |
| `matchScore` | `integer` | | Numeric match confidence (0-100). Companion to the matchConfidence categorical enum. Agents use this for filtering and ranking — 'show me everything above 70' is quantitative reasoning that categorical enums don't support |
| `humanVerdict` | one of `accepted`, `rejected`, `adjusted`, `not_reviewed` | | Human feedback on this comparable. Creates the learning feedback loop — agents learn which comparables humans accept, improving future searches |
| `rejectionReason` | `string` | | Why this comparable was rejected. Feeds back into agent learning — future searches avoid this type of mismatch |
